g3i_hero_subtitle: Dynamic electric performance meets modern versatility. Designed for your journey.
hero_feature_desc: Watch the G3I in motion and see its design from every angle.
g3i_proportions_desc1: The G3I  combines an aggressive, aerodynamic crossover silhouette with high ground clearance and wide track proportions.
g3i_proportions_desc2: Integrated flush door handles and dynamic roofline contours minimize wind resistance while maximizing cabin spatial efficiency.
g3i_torque_desc1: Engineered with a dual motor intelligent AWD system, the G3I instantly redistributes power across all four wheels based on real time road conditions.
g3i_torque_desc2: From steep mountain climbs to wet city streets, experience unyielding stability and instant throttle response.
g3i_cockpit_desc1: Designed for active lifestyles, the G3I features fold flat rear seats, a spacious front trunk and premium panoramic glass roof views.
g3i_cockpit_desc2: Advanced climate controls and a high definition digital cockpit keep performance and comfort perfectly balanced.
tech_subtitle: Engineered without compromise. Pure electric power meets surgical precision handling.
exclusive_subtitle: Exclusive benefits designed for the early pioneers of the G3I vision.
card_expo_desc: Experience the pinnacle of our G3I debut series with exclusive trims and performance upgrades.
card_gala_desc: Unlock premium savings on weekly and weekend rentals of the G3I.
card_seminar_desc: Seamless, rapid charging access for your G3I rental at partner stations nationwide.
journey_subtitle: Experience the fusion of elegance and intelligence firsthand at your nearest experience center.
footer_desc: Defining the future of electric mobility through precision engineering and avant-garde design. Join us in the journey towards sustainable luxury.
